scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

identityAssessment.finding: The imported feature lies in eastern Paraguay, approximately 56.30 to 54.68 degrees west and 26.13 to 24.02 degrees south. It is read as the Aché people, not the differently named Avá/Chiripá people. No precise 1492 boundary is certified.

scopeNotes: The AIP web page conflates Aché with Avá/Chiripá and was not used for claims.
Museum object dates remain ranges; recent collection material is not reassigned to the 1492 map year.
Northern Aché fieldwork is identified explicitly and is not generalised to all communities.
